sourceNotes: 统一菜单栏弹窗的标题图标与紧凑间距，网络改用与主窗口一致的图标
修复确认更新后更新源发生变化时提示不明确的问题，改为提示重新检查后再安装
修复跳过已撤回版本后，仍显示有更新的问题
修复部分应用卸载成功后仍显示失败、列表未更新或程序坞图标未移除的问题

en: Tighten title icon spacing across menu bar popovers and use the same network icon as the main window
When the update source changes after confirmation, clearly prompt users to check for updates again before installing
Fix skipped releases that have been withdrawn still appearing as available updates
Fix successful app removals being reported as failures, leaving stale list entries, or failing to remove Dock icons
